items.before: The commodity page explains the one-notification-per-ITAHC rule and has a shorter search hint
items.after: The commodity page explains that every ITAHC needs its own notification, and has a shorter search hint

items.before: The commodity page now has inset text: 'You must submit a separate notification for every single ITAHC. You must also submit a notification for goods that do not need an ITAHC.' The search hint reads 'You can search by common name (for example, cattle), commodity code (0102), or Latin name (Bos taurus).' and no longer says 'Enter at least 3 characters.', although 3 characters are still needed. In 'Help with commodity codes', '(opens in a new tab)' now sits on its own line after the Trade Tariff link. The search itself and the commodity list are unchanged until commodities come from the master reference data.
items.after:
The commodity page now has inset text:

'You must submit a separate notification for every single ITAHC. You must also submit a notification for goods that do not need an ITAHC.'

The search hint now reads:

'You can search by common name (for example, cattle), commodity code (0102), or Latin name (Bos taurus).'

The hint no longer says 'Enter at least 3 characters.'

Search still needs 3 characters.

In 'Help with commodity codes', '(opens in a new tab)' now sits on its own line after the Trade Tariff link.

The search itself and the commodity list are unchanged.

They stay as they are until commodities come from the master reference data.

items.after: Commodity page and Commodity details match Design Release 2.1 for: wording, the Species column, the 'Select a commodity' error, the soft Save and return, and the error order

items.before: Pressing 'Save and continue' on the commodity page with nothing chosen now shows 'Select a commodity' on the search box, between its label and hint, whether or not search results are listed, and the error summary link goes to the search box.
items.after:
A trader may press 'Save and continue' on the commodity page with nothing chosen.

The page now:

- shows 'Select a commodity' on the search box, between its label and hint
- does this whether or not search results are listed
- links the error summary to the search box

items.before: The unweaned animals question is not asked for cats and dogs. Now, if a trader changes their choice so that every animal is a cat or a dog, a saved answer to that question is cleared and no longer shows on the review.
items.after:
The unweaned animals question is not asked for cats and dogs.

Now, if a trader changes their choice so that every animal is a cat or a dog:

- a saved answer to that question is cleared
- the answer no longer shows on the review

items.before: The commodity details page caption now reads 'Description of the goods'. The selected commodities table gains a 'Species' column listing the Latin names chosen under each commodity, for example '0102 | Cow | Bos taurus'. The name 'Cow' stays until commodities come from the master reference data.
items.after:
The commodity details page caption now reads 'Description of the goods'.

The selected commodities table has a new 'Species' column.

It lists the Latin names chosen under each commodity. For example, '0102 | Cow | Bos taurus'.

The name 'Cow' stays until commodities come from the master reference data.

items.after: Commodity page and Commodity details match Design Release 2.1 for: wording, the Species column, the 'Select a commodity' error, the soft Save and return, and the error order

items.before: With two species missing their answers, the error summary now lists every 'number of animals' error first, then every 'number of packages' error, each linking to its box. The number of packages is now required on each line that asks for it; a line that does not ask for it can still be saved without one.
items.after:
When two species are missing their answers, the error summary now lists:

- every 'number of animals' error first
- then every 'number of packages' error

Each error links to its box.

The number of packages is now required on each line that asks for it.

A line that does not ask for it can still be saved without one.
